function getNextWake(now) {
    const target = new Date(now);
    for (const [hours, minutes] of WAKE_TIMES) {

    target.setUTCDate(target.getUTCDate() + 1);
    target.setUTCHours(0, 7, 0, 0);
    return target;
}
